name: 曼陀罗
overview: The plot revolves around the "forced love" of the cunning CEO Chen Changzhi for Zhao Man, a newcomer to the workplace: the male protagonist devises a plan to break up the female protagonist's relationship with her boyfriend, due to a childhood obsession, and lures her into the trap with well-paying jobs, mansions, and studies at Harvard. The story then unfolds into a mutual redemption.
